prompt:
Write a clinical treatment summary (about 150 words) by the treating provider for a patient with back strain after a hit while turning left. The patient had 30 visits. No names, no dates. (Internal reference C-1360; do not mention it.) Work these facts into the text naturally, in your own words, without listing them:
- The reported injury matches the kind and force of the crash well.
- Treatment followed a usual course and tapered off as the patient improved.
- Some exam findings support the injury; other tests are normal.
- No earlier injury to the same body area is known.
- The bills show no repeated charges.
text:
Treatment Summary

The patient is a synthetic claimant presenting with lumbar strain following a collision sustained while the vehicle was turning left, when the patient's vehicle was struck by another vehicle. The mechanism and force of impact are consistent with the reported low back injury. Over the course of care, the patient attended 30 visits consisting of physical therapy, manual therapy, home exercise instruction, and medication management. Early visits focused on pain control and restoring range of motion, and frequency was reduced as function improved, consistent with a typical recovery pattern. Examination revealed paraspinal muscle tenderness and reduced lumbar flexion that support the diagnosis, while neurological screening and straight-leg raise testing were within normal limits. No prior injury to the lumbar region is documented in the available history. Billing records reflect single charges for each service rendered with no duplicated entries. At discharge the patient was improving and was advised to continue the home program as needed.
